services.name: Extraterrestrial Escape
services.desc: Introducing Extraterrestrial Escape! You and your friends have been abducted by aliens after getting too close to exposing their existence. The aliens have you imprisoned in their laboratory. You have one hour to escape and return to Earth before the aliens come back and start their experiments. Caution: This room involves being restrained in a chair for a short amount of 1 Hour 2-3 Players

services.name: Mob Boss Break-In
services.desc: Mob Boss Break In! Now is the time crew, you have been tasked with breaking into a notorious mob boss's office. He has gone too far and in order to stop him from taking out your boss, you need to steal a very important document... his hit list. You have one hour, and can only use your flashlights to light your way. Good Luck Caution: You spend majority of this room in the dark. Flashlights are 1 Hour 2-8 People

services.name: Western Jail Break
services.desc: Houdini is gone now and as his apprentice, it’s your job to fill his shoes and help his legacy live on! There’s just one problem, he left all his secrets hidden in his dressing room. Do you have what it takes to learn his tricks and make magic Can you break out of the Sheriff's office in time?
